units: <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 7:1">Nidd. VII, 1</cite> <he>וכמה היא שְׁרִיָּיתָן וכ׳</he> and how long must they be soaked? Twenty-four hours in tepid water; <cite ref="Niddah 22b">ib. 22ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Niddah 56a">56ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ma'aser Sheni 2:1">Tosef. Maas. Sh. II, 1</cite> <he>חוץ משִׁירְיָיתָהּ</he> except putting it in water; Y. ib. II, 53ᶜ <he>משליתה</he> (corr. acc.).
